reason: The mechanism is real: in app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6:196-201 the new `_ids` branch maps each id through `_lookupSubType`, which returns undefined when `root[pluralize(subType)]` is absent (store.js.es6:168-169), then unconditionally assigns the array and deletes the `_ids` key, unlike the singular branch at 203-207 which only deletes on a hit. It is latent, though: the cited `featured_user_badges` example (app/serializers/user_serializer.rb:73) is hydrated by hand in user.js.es6:303-308, not via a `__rest_serializer` response, and the only `_ids` payload this patch sends through the store (embedding_serializer.rb:3) has a matching root key.
